articles.standfirst: Mykhailo Mudryk accuses Ukraine legend Andriy Shevchenko of lying about the circumstances surrounding the winger's positive drugs test as his dispute with the country's football federation continues.

timeline.text: Shevchenko accuses Mudryk camp of 'baseless slander'
Shevchenko lying about drugs test claims - Mudryk

gist: Andriy Shevchenko accused Mykhailo Mudryk's camp of seeking a false scapegoat for a doping test.
Mudryk blamed the Ukrainian Association of Football for his failed test and subsequent 20-month ban.
Shevchenko denied the allegations, defending the association and asking Mudryk to retract his comments.

sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Andriy Shevchenko stated that Mykhailo Mudryk's representatives repeatedly asked for a football federation employee to falsely take the blame for Mudryk's positive test for meldonium. Mudryk, suspended from November 2024 to July 2026, blamed the Ukrainian Association of Football for the failed test, claiming it happened on international duty and criticizing a lack of support.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Shevchenko called the claims baseless slander and defended the professionalism of association staff, while Mudryk argued the handling of the matter delayed his return to football.

fivew: Andriy Shevchenko accused Mykhailo Mudryk's representatives of asking an employee to falsely take the blame for a positive drugs test.
Mudryk blamed the Ukrainian Association of Football for his failed drugs test, prompting a public response from Shevchenko.
